items.title: EBAY Paid Holders $19 Billion While The Stock Trailed The Market
items.summary: The online marketplace sent owners a torrent of cash, yet the stock trailed the pack. Here is the accounting of what that trade-off actually bought.

items.title: BBY Raises FY27 Outlook as Ads and Marketplace Lift Profitability
items.summary: Best Buy raised its fiscal 2027 outlook as Ads and Marketplace support margins, while core growth offsets computing and cost pressures.

items.title: Is BBY a Buy as Growth Improves but Valuation Climbs Above Its Median?
items.summary: Best Buy's higher guidance, rising earnings estimates and stronger cash flow improve the setup, but valuation and memory inflation temper upside.

items.title: Can BBY Sustain Its 17.9% Three-Month Rally as Growth Drivers Broaden?
items.summary: Best Buy's 17.9% three-month rally gains support from stronger Q2 results, raised fiscal 2027 guidance and broader growth, though risks remain.

items.title: Should You Buy Walmart Stock After a 14% Decline in Six Months?
items.summary: Walmart's 14% six-month slide improves its entry point, but premium valuation, cost pressures and weaker estimates argue for patience.

items.title: Macy's Stock Down 5% Despite Q2 Earnings Beat, FY'26 View Raised
items.summary: M's Q2 earnings and sales beat estimates and the company raises its fiscal 2026 outlook, yet shares fall 4.7% as investors weigh a Q3 loss and softer comps.

items.title: Popular women's clothing chain closes 177 stores
items.summary: The company calls it “store optimization,” but for customers, it means nearly 30% fewer locations to try clothes on.

items.title: GameStop store closures could benefit Target
items.summary: GameStop keeps closing locations, and Target keeps picking up toy and collectibles sales.
